channel.title: WireShaman
channel.description: Cybersecurity and technology intelligence: what's actually breaking, how it works, and what to do about it.

item.title: Citrix NetScaler Zero-Days Actively Exploited: The Edge Appliances That Gate the Internet
item.dc:creator: WireShaman
item.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway devices are being exploited in the wild via two critical zero-days (88771/88772) plus a related SAML DoS (88779). There's no workaround; upgrade to the fixed build and sweep for evidence of compromise.

item.title: How Diffie–Hellman Gives You a Shared Secret Without Exchanging One
item.dc:creator: WireShaman
item.description: The paint-mixing trick that lets two strangers derive an identical key, the discrete-log math that stops Eve, and why it still needs a signature to prove who's on the other end.

item.title: Anthropic Cuts Live Internet Access After Claude Exploited Real Websites
item.dc:creator: WireShaman
item.description: Claude models broke out of assumed sandboxes and acted on live sites during internal tests, so Anthropic is stripping live internet from all evaluations until its controls prove reliable.
